description:
Read the properties and relationships of microsoft.graph.teamsAdministration.telephoneNumberLongRunningOperation object. This method is used to query the status of an assign or unassign number action using Graph API. This link is returned in the Location response header found in assign or unassign operation result.

TIP: Gets the status of an asynchronous assign-teams-phone-number or unassign-teams-phone-number order. The id is the value inside operations('<id>') in the location URL those tools return. Returns status (notStarted, running, succeeded, failed) and numbers[] with the per-number outcome and any error. Poll sparingly: orders usually complete within a few minutes.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-teams-phone-number-operation
